zh: 我嗓子疼，还流鼻涕。
en: I've got a {sore} throat and a runny nose.

zh: 我站起来太快的时候感到头晕。
en: I felt {dizzy|faint|light-headed|lightheaded} when I stood up too fast.

zh: 我的脚踝扭伤后肿起来了。
en: My ankle is {swollen|puffy} after I twisted it.

zh: 我对花生过敏。
en: I'm {allergic} to peanuts.

zh: 她戒烟以后看起来非常健康。
en: She looks really {healthy|well} since she quit smoking.

zh: 我病了一整个星期，所以待在家里。
en: I've been {sick|ill|unwell} all week, so I stayed home.

zh: 蚊子咬的包真的很痒。
en: The mosquito bites are really {itchy}.

zh: 打针一点也不疼。
en: The injection wasn't {painful|sore} at all.

zh: 待在家里吧，流感的传染性很强。
en: Stay home; the flu is very {contagious|infectious}.

zh: 手术后他疼得很厉害，是剧烈的疼痛。
en: He was in {severe|intense|terrible} pain after the operation.

zh: 我妻子怀孕六个月了。
en: My wife is six months {pregnant}.

zh: 天太冷，我的手指冻得麻木了。
en: My fingers went {numb} in the cold.

zh: 我今天感觉好多了，谢谢。
en: I'm feeling much {better} today, thanks.

zh: 我鼻子堵了，只能用嘴呼吸。
en: My nose is {blocked|stuffy|congested}, so I have to breathe through my mouth.

zh: 医生说我稍微有点超重。
en: The doctor said I'm slightly {overweight}.

zh: 看牙医之前我总是感到焦虑。
en: I always feel {anxious|nervous|worried} before seeing the dentist.

zh: 别担心，只是轻微的伤。
en: Don't worry, it's only a {minor|small|slight} injury.

zh: 你脸色苍白，你还好吗？
en: You look {pale}; are you feeling all right?

zh: 四十岁以后应该定期体检。
en: You should have {regular} check-ups after forty.

zh: 我肠胃不舒服，午饭就不吃了。
en: I've got an {upset} stomach, so I'll skip lunch.
